title: On the Weighted AM--GM Inequality and Refined Inequalities Between Arithmetic Functions
content: Let \( \varphi(n) \), \( \psi(n) \) and \( \sigma(n) \) denote the Euler totient function and the Dedekind function respectively. Using improved versions of the weighted AM-GM inequality, we obtain a series of sharp upper bounds for  \( \varphi(n)^{\varphi(n)} \psi(n)^{\psi(n)} \quad \text{and} \quad \varphi(n)^{\psi(n)} \psi(n)^{\varphi(n)} \),  improving previous bounds showed by Sándor and Atanassov.
